My dear [Miss Sewell](/person/1301),
I was so hurried that I could not go to [Macmillan](/person/939) yesterday so I am writing.
I have done the notes[^1] - the Joyeuse Garde beats both [Mary Coleridge](/person/351) and me, we both thought it a real castle on the Seine - and never heard of its being an Order.

Michaud’s [Histoire de Croisades](/organisation/116) has almost exactly the same about Simeon & his persecutions as Milman, and I dont know where to find more - in fact I think Milman copied him
Roman must be Norman

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: These were the notes to the anthology of historical writing [Historical Selections](/book/71) which they had jointly compiled.
